name: greenhouse
description: Smart plant irrigation control. Talks to a running greenhouse-server over MCP to read soil moisture / temperature / humidity / light, drive irrigators (start, stop, log manual watering, emergency stop-all) and set their reservoir/flow capacity, inspect typed decision logs, manage the alert inbox, track plant health and its timeline, monitor device and system health, set vacation windows (reservoir-aware rationing so water lasts the trip) and per-cluster irrigation windows, run data-quality reports, set quiet hours, tune irrigation config (per-cluster overrides inheriting global defaults), and toggle push-notification (ntfy) preferences. Trigger whenever the user asks anything about their plants, soil, watering, irrigation schedule, quiet hours, sensor readings, irrigator status, blocked drips, leaks, alerts, plant health, or system health — even when they don't say 'greenhouse'.
